outcome: Cardiac structural anomalies (e.g., flow across foramen ovale, distensible atrial septal membranes, patent ductus arteriosus)
Cardiac functional anomalies (e.g., right ventricular wall hypertrophy, chamber enlargement)
cohort: Seven calves (4 females, 3 males) derived from in vitro produced (IVP) embryos and referred to Cornell University for prolonged gestation.
finding: Calves with Large Offspring Syndrome (LOS)/Abnormal Offspring Syndrome (AOS) and prolonged gestation exhibit abnormal cardiac phenotypes, including large foramen ovale with thin and abnormally distensible atrial septa, patent ductus arteriosus, and right ventricular hypertrophy.
